title: UI: Library panel component
description: Implement LibraryPanel.tsx in packages/authoring-ui/src/LibraryPanel.tsx. Shows library items in a list with: icon (symbol/bitmap/sound), name, type label. Clicking selects item. Double-clicking a symbol opens it for editing. Has a search/filter input at top. Props: { doc, selectedItemId, onSelectItem, onEditSymbol, onDeleteItem, onRenameItem }. Render it in Shell.tsx in the right panel area (check current right panel structure). Build must pass.
